text:
Alex Kim: Urgent: our private inference clusters allowed connections to the cloud metadata IP from model containers. Detected by runtime monitors in us-east-1 and eu-central-1. Potential information exposure (instance metadata / temporary credentials). Treat as P0 - immediate action required.

sec-bot: Automated alert: runtime-security: metadata-server-probe detected (count=7) on private-prod-inference-001, private-prod-inference-002. Ticket INC-2026-445 created.

Maria Chen: Ack. Can you paste the snippet of evidence and exact cluster names? @ops-sre

Alex Kim: Logs attached to INC-2026-445. Affected clusters: private-prod-inference-us-east-1, private-prod-inference-eu-central-1. Window: 2026-03-21 02:14-02:18 UTC. No confirmed exfil but assume worst-case.

Jordan Patel: Quick mitigations we should do now:
- Block 169.254.169.254 at node and pod level
- Apply a K8s NetworkPolicy to deny egress to metadata IP for inference pods
- Ensure no containers running with NET_ADMIN or privileged; enforce seccomp/apparmor profiles

Alex Kim: Node-level emergency commands (run on nodes if CI rollout will take longer):
```
iptables -I OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254/32 -j DROP
iptables -I FORWARD -d 169.254.169.254/32 -j DROP
```
K8s NetworkPolicy example to apply to inference namespace:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-metadata-egress
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: inference
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 169.254.169.254/32
    ports: []
```

ops-sre: On it. I'll push the node-level iptables emergency change to the two clusters now, then apply NetworkPolicy via infra repo PR. ETA ~30m.

Maria Chen: Note: Hosted API and Dedicated customers are not affected by this issue (their metadata paths are not reachable from our managed runtime). This is specific to Private deployments. We'll prepare a customer notification draft.

Jordan Patel: Any legitimate exceptions? Some init containers fetch metadata for tagging at startup. Need a small opt-out flow.

Alex Kim: Exemption process: open a ticket in #sec-exemptions with justification and duration. Temporary allow via pod annotation `sec-infra/allow-metadata=true` only after Security + Infra approval. All exemptions logged and reviewed.

sec-bot: Post-patch scan reminder: run `sec-scan run --name metadata-probe --clusters private-prod-*` after changes.

ops-sre: Node-level iptables applied to us-east-1 and eu-central-1 nodes. NetworkPolicy PR created: https://git.internal/infra/cluster-policies/pull/342 (PR includes manifest + rollout job).

Maria Chen: Deadline: node blocks + NetworkPolicies must be in place across all Private clusters by EOD UTC 2026-03-22. If you hit blockers, escalate to @security-lead.

Jordan Patel: I'll update the detection rules to alert on repeated probes and add a synthetic probe job to verify block efficacy. :shield:

Alex Kim: Thanks. I'll prepare the incident summary and a customer comms template for Private customers. Follow-up in INC-2026-445.
